title: Truth-Functional Connectives
summary: This chapter explains negation, conjunction, disjunction, conditional, and biconditional operators.

answers.question: Translate into symbols: Not both P and Q.
answers.explanation: The phrase 'not both' negates a conjunction.

answers.question: Translate into symbols: Either P or Q, but not both.
answers.explanation: Exclusive disjunction can be represented as ordinary disjunction plus a negated conjunction.
